translations.web: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?
translations.bsb: Why do you look at the speck in your brother’s eye but fail to notice the beam in your own eye?
translations.kjv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
translations.asv: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
